The worst part was when we arrived for the procedure. When it was time to pay, the clinic said we could pay in two installments.
The first time, another staff member informed us that there was a 150 baht sterilization fee for the instruments, and that the next time, we didn't have to pay. We accepted and acknowledged that.
The second time, the LGBTQ woman came and charged us an additional 150 baht. We were confused and protested. When we saw the bill, everything was clearly stated: there was no additional 150 baht. And the lady kept arguing, saying that no matter how many times I visited, I had to pay. I was confused as to what their standard was. One person said they had to pay, the other said they didn't.
In the end, we didn't pay the additional 150 baht that day because we protested, and the lady gave in so easily. It's confusing.
